description: Newser's writers and editors carefully select approximately 45 of the most essential, entertaining, and delightfully quirky news items to cover each day. And at just two paragraphs each, our sharply written stories pack in only the most interesting details??none of the boring stuff??and are quick and easy to digest, especially on the go. And we're pretty to look at, too: our signature grid, reformatted for Windows 8, lets eye-catching photos and short and snappy headlines do the talking, providing a vivid snapshot of the day's news.
